details: This package is a third-party Baileys WhatsApp library fork that manipulates the installing user's WhatsApp account without consent. In lib/Socket/index.js it hardcodes CLARISSA_NEWSLETTER_JID = '120363418729056952@newsletter' and registers a connection.update handler that, whenever the socket reports connection === 'open', calls socket.newsletterFollow(CLARISSA_NEWSLETTER_JID): the consumer's account is automatically subscribed to the author's newsletter channel on every connection, failures are swallowed, and no configuration option or documentation exposes the behaviour. The package additionally declares a dependency named 'risayap-disabled'@0.0.0 that has no role in the code, depends on 'whatsapp-rust-bridge'@0.5.4 (a bundled native module re-exported as md5/hkdf/LTHashAntiTampering/expandAppStateKeys), and ships a preinstall hook, engine-requirements.js, that aborts installation with process.exit(1) unless the environment variable CLARISSA_INSTALL is set to 1.
